meta_title: About TrueNorth Living — Recovery Housing in North Texas
meta_description: Who we are, how our sober living homes are run, and what we believe about recovery housing in the greater DFW area
hero_title: True North is a Direction, Not a Destination.
hero_body: You don't arrive at it. You just keep checking whether you're still pointed the right way — and it helps to have people around who'll tell you when you're not.
story_body: Recovery is about more than staying sober—it's about building a meaningful life. We founded TrueNorth Living to provide more than simply a place to stay. We wanted to create recovery homes where individuals can find structure, accountability, community, and practical support as they move toward stable, independent lives. Every decision we make is guided by the belief that people in recovery deserve a safe environment and a strong foundation for their future.

values.title: A house, not a facility
values.body: Residents have keys. Residents cook. Residents vote on house issues. Nobody is a patient here.

values.title: Dignity is not a reward
values.body: You don't earn respect by staying sober long enough. It's the starting condition, and it's not revocable.

values.title: We say the hard thing early
values.body: If a house isn't working for someone, we have that conversation while there's still time to fix it — not at the point of exit.

values.title: Recovery outlasts residency
values.body: Alumni keep house keys to the Sunday dinner. The relationship doesn't end when the rent does.

standards_body: Texas does not license sober living homes at the state level, which means the burden of proving quality falls on operators. We think that's worth taking seriously rather than hiding behind.

standards.title: TROHN certification — in progress
standards.body: We are working toward certification with the Texas Recovery Oriented Housing Network (TROHN), the state affiliate of the National Alliance for Recovery Residences. We are not certified yet, and this page will say so plainly the day that changes.
standards.short: Working toward TROHN certification, the Texas NARR affiliate. Not certified yet.

standards.title: Fair housing
standards.body: Recovery is protected under the Fair Housing Act and the ADA. We follow that in every admission decision.
standards.short: Recovery is protected under the Fair Housing Act and the ADA. We follow that in every admission.

standards.title: Clear house agreement
standards.body: A written agreement covers rate, rules, testing and guests. You get your copy before you move in, not after.
standards.short: A written agreement covers rate, rules, testing and guests. You get your copy before you move in.

standards.title: Small enough to know everyone
standards.body: Every resident is known by name by the people running the house. Problems get noticed the day they start.
standards.short: Every resident is known by name by the people running the house.

team.name: Boede Gibson
team.bio: After witnessing the impact addiction has on families and close friends, Boede co-founded TrueNorth Living to create a place where individuals can rediscover purpose, accountability, and community. His vision is to build a lasting recovery community where residents are proud to say they were part of TrueNorth Living and continue to thrive long after leaving its doors.

team.name: Rex Gibson
team.bio: Dr. Rex has spent his 30-year career caring for children and serving families throughout his community. Inspired by both his personal experiences and a lifelong commitment to helping others, he co-founded TrueNorth Living to provide a structured, supportive environment where individuals can build stability, independence, and a foundation for lasting recovery.
